definitions.meaning: Rejoicing in ample space in which to move (applied to the dove when sent from the ark)

quotations.old_english: Seó culufre wíde fleáh óþ ðæt heó rúmgál reste stówe funde
quotations.english: far the dove flew, in flight unconfined rejoicing, until a place of rest she found (cf. heó rúme fleáh, 87, 29; Gen. 1456)

source_text: rúm-gál; adj. Rejoicing in ample space in which to move (applied to the dove when sent from the ark) :-- Seó culufre wíde fleáh óþ ðæt heó rúmgál reste stówe funde far the dove flew, in flight unconfined rejoicing, until a place of rest she found (cf. heó rúme fleáh, 87, 29; Gen. 1456), Cd. Th. 88, 16; Gen. 1466.
